verdict.rationale: Omnara documents configurable approval gates: you decide which actions need approval, and agents can pause for input (omnara-docs-8). That could plausibly gate a PR-creating action, but nothing describes a diff view of the agent's code changes or a PR workflow. One community user also says tools in this space don't solve reviewing agent-written code (omnara-comm-5), which lowers confidence. Missing for 10: a diff review UI for agent changes, explicit approve-before-PR or GitHub pull request integration, and any independent hands-on corroboration.
